title: HouseholdVoice
description: VOICES-03: a voice an owner or admin made from one reference clip (6 to 30 seconds), usable by the whole household once made. The hub is the master: it keeps this record and the clip, and sends the clip to the voice engine with each request. No consent block: creation is admin-only and unrestricted (SAFETY.md, owner-approved 2026-10-18). `temperature` is the sampling temperature handed to the Chatterbox Turbo engine for this voice (0.1 to 2.0; absent means the engine default); it was chosen by ear at 1.05 for the robot voice, and a higher value also raises pitch. `pitch_semitones` shifts the rendered audio after generation with formants kept (-12 to 12; absent means 0), because a clone can come out one or two semitones off its reference. Both are set by the person making the voice and are the voice's own, never a request parameter.

id.description: Also the value a person's `tts.voice_id` and a robot's `robot.voice.id` hold: a plain token, never an address.

label.description: The name the household sees, such as 'Cutey'.

created_by.description: The owner or admin who made the voice (provenance).

bytes.description: Size of the stored reference clip.

duration_seconds.description: Length of the reference clip; null for a voice made before the length was recorded.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for this voice; absent means the engine default.

pitch_semitones.description: Pitch offset in semitones applied to the rendered audio, formants kept; absent means 0.

hlc.description: Hybrid logical clock: wall_ms:counter:node (7.3), the same shape every other synced record type uses.
